title: Three Small Baking Tins  (三个小烤模)

segments.t: 十五分钟后，在热闹的咖啡馆厨房里，泰莎在木质台面上一字排开三个小圆烤模，而欧文和汉娜正把干净的白色围裙系在腰间。先完整听一遍这一幕。
Welcome to the Sunday Berry Cake Laboratory, apprentices! Hands washed and sleeves rolled?
Washed twice, Chef! I brought two baskets of ripe red berries and sweet almonds.
How are we going to solve the smudged blue ink at the bottom, Tessa?
We divide one batch of almond berry batter evenly across three small round tins.
Smart! Same cake inside every tin, with a different warm glaze brushed on top!
What are our three candidate glazes for the great afternoon taste test?
Tin One gets tart lemon juice, Tin Two gets crunchy raw sugar, Tin Three waits.
Why does Tin Three have to wait while One and Two go in first?
Because a good baker learns from the first two mistakes before crowning a winner!
Who is brave enough to serve as our strict, honest Chief Judge today?
Only one person in Linden Courtyard Inn never flatters anybody, even when dessert is free.
Go fetch Graham and his sharp pencil — the ovens are hot!
现在让我们走进这个烘焙实验室，逐句仔细分析。
Welcome to the Sunday Berry Cake Laboratory, apprentices! Hands washed and sleeves rolled?
“欢迎来到周日浆果蛋糕实验室，小学徒们！手洗干净、袖子挽起来了吗？”泰莎像老师一样迎接她的帮手们。laboratory 的重音位置因地区而异，在美式英语中读作 /ˈlæbrəˌtɔri/，重音在最前面。
Hands washed and sleeves rolled?
这是一个省略了助动词的简短问句，口语里非常自然。它的完整说法来自 roll up your sleeves（把袖子卷起来），引申为“撸起袖子大干一场”。
Washed twice, Chef! I brought two baskets of ripe red berries and sweet almonds.
“洗了两遍了，大厨！我带来了两篮熟透的红浆果和甜杏仁。”欧文干劲满满地答道。brought 是 bring（带来）的不规则过去式，与 thought 和 caught 押韵：
I brought two baskets
形容水果“熟透了、成熟的”用 ripe。另外，在美式英语中 almonds 里的字母 l 几乎不发音，读作 /ˈɑːmənz/。
How are we going to solve the smudged blue ink at the bottom, Tessa?
“泰莎，我们打算怎么解决最底下那块抹花的蓝墨水呢？”汉娜提出了今天的核心难题。表达计划和打算时，英语常用 be going to + 动词原形：
How are we going to solve
smudged（被抹花的、晕开的）形容墨水糊成一团。at the bottom 意思是“在底部”，这里指食谱卡片的最下方。
We divide one batch of almond berry batter evenly across three small round tins.
“我们把同一批杏仁浆果面糊平均分到三个小圆烤模里。”泰莎讲解了她的科学实验法。batch 指一次制作出来的“一批、一炉”。
evenly across three small round tins.
evenly 意思是“均匀地、平均地”。多个形容词排列时，大小要放在形状前面，所以只能说 small round，不能说 round small。tin 是“烤模、烤盘”，美式英语也常说 pan。
Smart! Same cake inside every tin, with a different warm glaze brushed on top!
“高明！每个烤模里都是一样的蛋糕，只是在表面刷上不同的温热糖釉！”欧文一下子明白了实验的逻辑。Smart! 单独用作感叹句时相当于“好主意！真聪明！”。
brushed on top!
brush 作动词时意思是“用刷子刷”，在厨房里指用烘焙刷涂抹。on top 表示“在表面、在上面”，中间不需要加冠词。
What are our three candidate glazes for the great afternoon taste test?
“今天下午大试吃的三个备选糖釉方案是什么呀？”汉娜想知道有哪些候选方案。中文常问“哪些是……”，而英语在这里习惯直接用 What are…?：
the great afternoon taste test?
taste test 是“试吃测试、品尝对比”。这里名词 candidate 直接放在 glazes 前面作定语，表示“备选的、候选的”。
Tin One gets tart lemon juice, Tin Two gets crunchy raw sugar, Tin Three waits.
“一号烤模刷酸爽柠檬汁，二号烤模撒脆粒原糖，三号烤模先等等。”泰莎像乐队指挥一样分配任务。万能动词 get 在这里相当于“分配到、得到”：
Tin One gets tart lemon juice,
tart 作形容词表示“酸爽可口的”；作名词 a tart 则指“水果挞”。raw sugar 是“原糖（未精制蔗糖）”，raw 与 saw 押韵。
Why does Tin Three have to wait while One and Two go in first?
“为什么一二号先进去，三号烤模非得等着呀？”欧文好奇地问道。表达客观上的“不得不、必须”用 have to；在一般现在时疑问句里，第三人称单数的 -s 体现在助动词 does 上：
Why does Tin Three have to wait
go in 字面意思是“进去”，这里指“进烤箱”。while 表示“在……的时候、而……”。
Because a good baker learns from the first two mistakes before crowning a winner!
“因为好的烘焙师会在评出优胜者之前，先从头两次的失误中吸取教训！”泰莎说出一番烘焙哲学。“从……中学习”用介词 from：learn from mistakes。再留意一下数词的语序：
the first two mistakes
英语把序数词放在基数词前面，说 first two（头两个），而不能说 two first。另外，介词 before 后面的动词要变成 -ing 形式：before crowning。
Who is brave enough to serve as our strict, honest Chief Judge today?
“今天谁有胆量担任我们严格又公正的首席裁判？”汉娜想找个敢说真话的人来当评委。短语 serve as 意思是“担任、充当”：
to serve as our strict, honest Chief Judge
brave 是“勇敢的、有胆量的”。honest 词首的 h 不发音，和 hour 一样，读作 /ˈɑːnɪst/。
Only one person in Linden Courtyard Inn never flatters anybody, even when dessert is free.
“在菩提树庭院客栈里，只有一个人从来不奉承任何人，哪怕甜点免费也是如此。”欧文心里已经有了人选。注意：英语同一句里通常不用双重否定，有了 never（从不），后面要用 anybody（任何人）而不是 nobody：
never flatters anybody,
flatter 意思是“奉承、恭维”。even when 相当于“哪怕……的时候”，free 在这里指“免费的”。
Go fetch Graham and his sharp pencil — the ovens are hot!
“快去把格雷厄姆和他那支削尖的铅笔叫来——烤箱已经热了！”泰莎下达了这一幕的最后一道指令。美式英语口语常说 go fetch，两个动词之间省略 to；fetch 表示“去把某人或某物叫来/拿来”：
Go fetch Graham
sharp 意思是“锋利的、尖的”，形容头脑时则表示“敏锐的”。hot（热的）也常用来形容天气：it is hot（天气很热）。现在请从头到尾以正常语速再听一遍完整对话。
Welcome to the Sunday Berry Cake Laboratory, apprentices! Hands washed and sleeves rolled?
Washed twice, Chef! I brought two baskets of ripe red berries and sweet almonds.
How are we going to solve the smudged blue ink at the bottom, Tessa?
We divide one batch of almond berry batter evenly across three small round tins.
Smart! Same cake inside every tin, with a different warm glaze brushed on top!
What are our three candidate glazes for the great afternoon taste test?
Tin One gets tart lemon juice, Tin Two gets crunchy raw sugar, Tin Three waits.
Why does Tin Three have to wait while One and Two go in first?
Because a good baker learns from the first two mistakes before crowning a winner!
Who is brave enough to serve as our strict, honest Chief Judge today?
Only one person in Linden Courtyard Inn never flatters anybody, even when dessert is free.
Go fetch Graham and his sharp pencil — the ovens are hot!
三个小圆烤模正滑向温暖的烤箱，而菩提树街最严格的试吃裁判也即将上任。我们在下一幕见！
See you next time!
